title: Operations Automated Methodology Component Registry
approved_baseline: Operations Automated v0.7 approved for internal validation
authority_rule: This registry is a proposed machine-readable index. It must retrieve and cite the linked human-readable artefact before applying meaning. It cannot paraphrase, supersede, approve or change that artefact.

components.title: Founder Charter
components.scope: Purpose, beliefs, human responsibility, product boundary and founder authority.
required_questions: What purpose and intended value govern this work?
Which human authority and obligations cannot be delegated?
authority_boundaries: Jamie Peppard retains methodology meaning, release and consequential authority during the founder-controlled phase.
evidence_expectations: cite the approved Charter and any exact bounded Decision

components.title: User-defined Value
components.scope: Define beneficiaries, value priorities, minimum outcomes, constraints and decision authority before deciding what better means.
required_questions: Who defines value here?
Which minimum outcomes and obligations remain gates?
authority_boundaries: User priorities cannot remove applicable legal, safety, ethical or human obligations.
evidence_expectations: record user judgement separately from evidence and AI inference

components.title: Human-led Automation, AI and Agents
components.scope: Control the decision to retain human work or delegate bounded work to automation, AI or agents.
required_questions: What is the lowest justified level of delegation?
Who owns the outcome and can stop or recover the capability?
authority_boundaries: Technical ability does not create permission or transfer accountability.
evidence_expectations: task boundary, information permission, evaluation, exception and recovery evidence

components.title: TIGIPI human-factors heuristic
components.scope: Think without assumed knowledge, test with an outsider or novice and prepare for mistakes, distraction and pressure.
required_questions: What depends on hidden knowledge?
Can error be detected, reversed and recovered safely?
authority_boundaries: The heuristic must not ridicule people or blame an individual for system-designed error.
evidence_expectations: first-use observation with a person who does not share the designer's context where proportionate

components.title: Operational Lenses
components.scope: Connected views of value, people, demand, flow, authority, risk, information, technology and learning.
required_questions: Which lenses can materially change this outcome?
What cross-lens effect or trade-off could be hidden?
authority_boundaries: A consequential lens may be excluded only with a recorded reason.
evidence_expectations: real work, exceptions and affected people rather than documented process alone

components.title: Outside-in journey
components.scope: Begin with the primary customer, service user, stakeholder or beneficiary journey and intended outcome.
required_questions: Whose journey gives this operation purpose?
Where does value, harm, delay or failure appear?
authority_boundaries: Customer first does not mean customer only; other affected people and obligations remain visible.
evidence_expectations: observable journey evidence and stated limitations

components.title: Operational value system
components.scope: Move from the journey into the end-to-end operation that must deliver and sustain the outcome.
required_questions: What is the first operational event?
What must happen across normal, exceptional, degraded and recovery routes?
authority_boundaries: Operational design cannot override specialist authority or minimum obligations.
evidence_expectations: work types, decisions, interfaces, variation, failure and outcome measures

components.title: Operational Coverage Model
components.scope: Make methodology breadth and depth visible without implying operational maturity, certification or completeness.
required_questions: Which capabilities are material?
Is current guidance identified, outlined, usable, validated or publishable?
authority_boundaries: Coverage depth and artefact approval status remain separate.
evidence_expectations: case evidence before raising a coverage level

components.title: Cross-functional Interface Model
components.scope: Define the purpose, exchange, authority, dependency, escalation and recovery at material interfaces.
required_questions: What must move across this boundary?
Who advises, performs, approves, commits, accepts risk or stops work?
authority_boundaries: The Methodology governs the operational interface, not the whole specialist profession.
evidence_expectations: two-way exchange and evidence that the receiver can act

components.title: Connected Work, Risk and Control
components.scope: Connect cases, requests, incidents, problems, risks, controls, decisions and learning without forcing one linear hierarchy.
required_questions: What original need and outcome connect these records?
What remains exposed if a treatment is rejected, delayed or fails?
authority_boundaries: AI may prepare evidence and recommendations but cannot accept risk or commit funding.
expected_outputs: governed next action and review trigger
evidence_expectations: decision, owner, rationale, conditions and residual exposure

components.title: Operational Readiness Path
components.scope: Evidence-based readiness from operational basics through automation, AI and bounded agents.
required_questions: What is established, inconsistent or unknown?
What is the lowest complexity that creates justified value?
authority_boundaries: Readiness is a profile, not an authority-granting score.
expected_outputs: next improvement, control and recovery conditions
evidence_expectations: specific goal, work type and environment evidence
review_triggers: failure shows readiness cannot be sustained

components.title: OPERATE Improvement and Implementation Cycle
components.scope: Observe, Prioritise, Examine, Redesign, Automate, Test and Evolve a proportionate improvement.
required_questions: What actually happens and why?
Does the change work under normal, exceptional, adverse and degraded conditions?
authority_boundaries: Stage movement is not approval; consequential designs, delegation and risk remain human decisions.
expected_outputs: retained lesson, decision or no-change reason
evidence_expectations: current reality, causes, alternatives, tests, failure and recovery

components.title: Methodology Output Contract
components.scope: Return useful analysis and a governed next action rather than questions, fields or stage completion alone.
required_questions: What useful result can be returned now?
What evidence, uncertainty, recommendation and human control point must be visible?
authority_boundaries: A recommendation is not approval; a click, silence or supplied information cannot authorise consequence.
evidence_expectations: separate recorded fact, user judgement, AI inference, assumption and recommendation

components.title: Proportionate Application and Delivery Modes
components.scope: Use one method at different depths through Ask and assessment or project modes.
required_questions: Can the substantive question responsibly be answered?
What is the shortest responsible route?
relevant_operational_lenses: material lenses selected for the case
authority_boundaries: User preference affects depth but cannot remove material evidence, obligation or authority needs.
expected_outputs: direct provisional answer or smallest useful route
evidence_expectations: answerability, limitations and only questions that could change the conclusion

components.title: Actionable and Self-guided Decision Aids
components.scope: Provide the shortest reusable aid that lets a user make independent progress.
required_questions: Will an aid improve the decision?
What complexity earns its place?
authority_boundaries: A formula or score is a decision aid, not evidence, safety or approval.
expected_outputs: smallest usable checklist, worksheet, example or record
evidence_expectations: transparent inputs, limitations, gates and sensitivity where material

components.title: Activation and First Use
components.scope: Distinguish creation from the user's ability to reach, activate, understand, act, observe, recover and retain.
required_questions: Can the intended user complete the first useful action?
What happens when activation fails?
authority_boundaries: Activation does not authorise installation, connection, credential storage or product approval.
expected_outputs: blocker, owner and recovery route where incomplete
evidence_expectations: target-environment or faithfully equivalent handover test

components.title: Human-AI Collaboration Method
components.scope: Govern interpretation, evidence, representation, mutual challenge, recovery, memory and retained interaction learning.
required_questions: What is the strongest contextual meaning?
What changed, remains disputed or needs a counter-test?
authority_boundaries: Fluency, engagement, silence and positive tone cannot create approval.
expected_outputs: visible evidence boundary and learning disposition
evidence_expectations: interaction outcome, correction, failure and recovery evidence

components.title: Methodology Evolution System
components.scope: Turn authorised questions, feedback, outcomes, failures, research and contradictions into traceable proposals, decisions and releases.
required_questions: What is the signal, source, boundary and strongest contextual meaning?
Is this answer correction, more evidence, methodology change, product change or no action?
authority_boundaries: The system improves evidence flow; it is not self-authorising.
evidence_expectations: source, permission, context, evidence, limitations, related signals, decision and outcome

components.title: Founder Challenge and Feedback Loop
components.scope: Use founder-initiated and daily evidence-backed challenges as controlled learning inputs.
required_questions: What case tests the methodology?
What changed after feedback and which counter-test could change the conclusion?
relevant_operational_lenses: material lenses selected for the challenge
authority_boundaries: A response is feedback, not approval; fatigue, silence or repetition are not convergence.
evidence_expectations: source mix, reliability, founder judgement, AI inference and unresolved disagreement

components.title: Methodology Assurance and Release Control
components.scope: Separate proposal, preparation, approval, merge, release, distribution, supersession and outcome review.
required_questions: What exact current and proposed meaning is being decided?
What becomes effective, where, under whose authority and with what recovery route?
authority_boundaries: Artefact status is authoritative; technical readiness, merge or publication cannot change it automatically.
evidence_expectations: approver, scope, version, date, conditions, effective and superseded content, product and prompt impact, migration and distribution
